eligibility_notes: Provisional: requires a CS/computing bachelor's (major in CS or Computer Engineering; related computing sciences). Geography BSc does not meet this on its face and no experience/bridging pathway was found on official pages; a possible Head-of-Department waiver was seen only in an unverified search summary. Not rejected because the non-CS rule requires an explicit statement of no alternative. English waived; GRE optional; 120 CAD fee; Fall deadline Dec 1 2026. Curriculum is generic CS (7 of 10 courses CS), low cloud/IS fit.
